items.title: Organize Imports removes DUPLICATE imports: the same path imported twice, the same name twice inside one brace group, and one name reachable through two import lines of the same module
items.body: Today Organize Imports sorts and groups but leaves duplicates. Wanted: (1) two identical `import a::b::C;` lines collapse to one; (2) `import a::{ B, B };` drops the repeat; (3) `import a::B;` and `import a::{ B, C };` (or two brace groups over the same module) merge into one group, by the formatter's existing grouping rule; (4) an alias is a different import (`import a::B as D;` stays beside `import a::B;`); (5) a module import and a member import of the same module (`import std::reactive;` and `import std::reactive::{ draft };`) are NOT duplicates and both stay. Decide whether `vilan fmt` does the same or only the code action (rec: the code action only - fmt does not delete code). A duplicate import should also carry a warning with a quick fix, if it does not already. Pins for each of the five cases, and that the action is idempotent.
